timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: I keep hearing about MCRA and MCSB. What's the difference?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: MCRA is the architecture blueprint. Shows how security services connect.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Cloud Security Benchmark. Twelve domains of security controls you must implement.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Twelve? That sounds like a lot of homework.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Identity management, network security, data protection, incident response, and more.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So MCRA shows the big picture and MCSB gives you the checklist?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Exactly. Architecture plus controls equals a complete security posture.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Do they map to compliance standards?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes. CIS, ISO 27001, NIST. MCSB covers multiple frameworks at once.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So one benchmark to rule them all?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: In the Microsoft cloud world, yes. MCSB is that comprehensive.
